thread:
Maya (Prod Mktg): Quick kickoff for the CaseLab customer story — aim is launch week aligned with the 4/21 webinar. Interview with Elaine (CaseLab CMO) set for Thu 4/14 10:00am PT. Deliverables: interview transcript, one cleared hero quote, two short pull-quotes, 30s social clip, headshot + logo. Nora, you owning the release/sign-off? Legal, what's your turnaround?

Nora (CS): Yep, Ill own the release flow and will join the interview. Ill upload signed form to S3 after the call.

Carlos (Content): Ill run the interview and pull quotes. Draft Qs: 1) Why Redwood? 2) Before vs after metrics (throughput, latency, cost) with numbers. 3) Ops/dev wins. 4) One-sentence business impact quote. Need concrete KPI numbers to use in the benchmark slide.

Jun (Design): Starting hero layout + social cut. Need high-res headshot and SVG logo. If CaseLab has brand gating rules, call them out now.

legal-team: We can review quote and release within 48 hours after final strings and signed release are uploaded. Please attach provenance (dashboard screenshot or CSV) for any specific percentage claims. Avoid fuzzy phrasing unless audited.

Elaine (CaseLab): We can share numbers: ~3.2x peak throughput and ~60% lower per-request inference cost after switching to Redwood. I'll upload logos and the signed release by Tue EOD.

Priya (PM): For the webinar: reserve a 10-minute demo + 5-minute Q&A for CaseLab. Maya/Carlos ok with that?

Carlos (Content): OK. Ill draft a short demo script and will extract quotes live. Early hero quote idea: "Redwoodcut our inference cost by roughly 60% while keeping quality intact."

legal-team: Prefer "approximately 60%" not "cut by over half" unless CaseLab wants stronger phrasing. Ask Elaine to initial the exact quote on the release.

Maya (Prod Mktg): Elaine already confirmed ~60% above. Carlos, drop the transcript excerpt here after the interview so legal can review.

Carlos (Content): Rough transcript excerpt from runthrough: 
Elaine: "We saw about a 3.2x jump in throughput and roughly a 60% reduction in inference cost after switching to Redwood. That allowed our ML team to iterate faster and ship convos to production sooner."

Carlos (Content): Hero candidate: "We saw about a 3.2x jump in throughput and roughly a 60% reduction in inference cost after switching to Redwood." Pull quotes: "60% reduction in inference cost" and "3.2x throughput".

legal-team: OK on phrasing. Please include a backup metric snapshot with the release.

Rishi (Ops): Proposed timeline: 4/14 interview; 4/16 draft post + legal review; 4/18 final assets; 4/20 embargo check; 4/21 publish + webinar.

Maya (Prod Mktg): Action list: Carlos  draft post + clip; Jun  design assets; Nora  signed release to S3; Legal  final quote approval; Priya  lock webinar slot. Ill collate everything into one checklist. :thumbsup:

Nora (CS): Uploading signed release to s3://redwood-marketing/caselab/release_signed.pdf by Tue EOD.

Jun (Design): Will share hero Figma after headshot is uploaded.

Elaine (CaseLab): Uploaded logos and release to the drive (DMed link). Excited to be part of the webinar.

Maya (Prod Mktg): Thanks all. Ill follow up with a doc tracking quotes, approvals and asset links.
